prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a bustling construction site where soft pigments bleed into the textured paper. On the far left, a foreman in a yellow hard hat stands with arms crossed, observing the progress. Next to him sits a rusty wheelbarrow filled with gray gravel. In the center foreground, a worker in blue overalls kneels on the dusty ground, carefully tying rebar. A brown dog lies patiently beside the kneeling worker, resting its chin on its paws. To the right of the dog, a stack of red bricks rises unevenly. Standing near the bricks is an engineer in a white shirt, pointing toward a large blueprint spread out on a wooden table. Leaning against the table is a tall ladder made of silver aluminum. Behind the engineer, a crane operator in an orange vest looks down from the cab of a towering yellow crane. In the background, a concrete mixer truck with a rotating drum is parked near a pile of sand. A pigeon perches on the edge of the unfinished wall above the mixer. The foreman is looking at the engineer. The engineer is pointing at the blueprint. The brown dog is sitting on the ground next to the worker in blue overalls. The worker in blue overalls is handing a tool to the foreman in the yellow hard hat. There is no heavy machinery noise depicted visually. There is no safety netting visible on the scaffolding.
